about_short_description.short_description: Kong Inc. is the AI connectivity company building the layer AI needs to reach its full potential with AI governance from day one.

product.name: Kong Konnect
product.description: A cloud-based API and AI connectivity platform for managing API gateways, AI traffic, event integrations, governance, analytics, developer access, and monetization.

product.name: Kong AI Gateway
product.description: A gateway for governing and routing LLM, agent, and MCP traffic with access control, prompt protection, token limits, semantic caching, provider routing, and AI observability.

product.name: Kong Gateway
product.description: An API gateway for routing, securing, transforming, and observing API traffic across cloud-native, hybrid, and self-managed environments.

product.name: Kong Event Gateway
product.description: A gateway for exposing and governing event-streaming traffic, including Kafka, with authentication, encryption, failover, routing, and controlled access beyond broker networks.

product.name: Kong Insomnia
product.description: An API development and testing client for REST, GraphQL, gRPC, and related protocols, with environments, collections, mock servers, automation, plugins, and API design governance.

product.name: Kong Mesh
product.description: A service mesh for managing service-to-service connectivity, traffic policies, security, and observability across Kubernetes, containers, virtual machines, and multi-zone environments.
